群山也会听从言语，

Even mountains heed a word,
if you know their names.

en: Very weak, but they come in huge crowds.

en:
Naglfar sinks in flames. But the distant sky is already burning, and Bifröst is collapsing.
Every god and every giant is marching toward the same plain.
A procession of the dead surges toward you!
Dark elves emerge from the mist!

Chapter "Ragnarök" complete.
Rating: rewards are based on survival time, kills and fates rewritten.
Returning to Lord God's Space...

en: A child of Loki. Cast into the sea by Odin, it grew until it encircled all of Midgard, biting its own tail. The moment it let go, the sea swallowed the land. Prophecy says Thor will slay it, then fall to its venom after nine steps.

en: A child of Loki. The gods bound it with Gleipnir, a chain forged by dwarves, at the cost of the war god Tyr's right hand. Now the chain is broken. It opens its jaws, upper jaw against the sky, lower jaw against the earth. Prophecy says it will swallow Odin.

keys: 天地巨口：吸引并吞噬，留有逃脱时间 · 绕圈狂奔 · 捡起格莱普尼尔碎片能束缚它 · 奥丁觉醒后，维达会来撕开它的嘴

en: He stood guard at the border of the realm of fire before the world was born. At the end of Ragnarök he will set the Nine Realms ablaze with a sword brighter than the sun. No one knows why he fights. He has simply waited for this moment, for an entire age.
